name: Motril (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and light blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Motril (a castle on blue within an inscribed bordure with the motto SEXIS FORMENSIS CIVITAS, and the title MUY NOBLE Y LEAL CIUDAD).
history: Municipal flag of Motril; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Motril arms — castle within an inscribed bordure, with motto and title
